results.criterion: AC1: Actual plan/apply/recover commands migrate a disposable Project with multiple PRDs, existing owners, shared tasks/proposals, local and cross-owner dependencies and active inbound references. Final catalog identities and intended link targets match the approved plan.
results.observation: Actual repository plan/apply/rerun CLI migrated two flat features alongside an existing owner and validated its cross-owner edge to demo/export/story/001.

results.criterion: AC2: Evidence/log payloads and lifecycle/review decisions retain original bytes/meaning. Already canonical shared local IDs survive, owner indexes and Project navigation resolve, and unreceipted terminal work does not become implementation authority.
results.observation: Tests independently compare evidence/log and existing PRD bytes; canonical shared ID and owner-local identity resolution remain valid; migration does not write work-completion receipts.

results.criterion: AC3: Bound STATUS uses final Project paths and catalog state and rolls back with publication failure. Unbound STATUS is reported without a fabricated directory binding or external write.
results.observation: Repository CLI created bound STATUS and byte-compared it with final catalog rendering; API tests prove rollback and unbound behavior.

results.criterion: AC4: Mechanical and non-mechanical proposal fingerprint changes receive the required distinct dispositions. Existing decisions remain traceable; a non-mechanical change cannot inherit fingerprint-bound approval silently.
results.observation: Planner proposal fingerprint classification distinguishes mechanical path mapping without auto-approving a new fingerprint; independent Spec review accepted its boundary.

results.criterion: AC5: The documented offline plan → review/approve → apply → verify/recover commands work without model calls or manual feature-record editing. Error guidance distinguishes plan regeneration, explicit ownership assignment, recovery and output drift. Migration and adapter-install approval boundaries are explicit.
results.observation: Updated task_project_skills.md, task_quick_task.md and stable consumer command knowledge document offline plan/approve/apply/recover commands and separate live-migration/install approvals.

results.criterion: AC6: Complete-command regressions cover missing/revoked authority, ambiguity, inventory drift, plan tampering, occupied/escaping/symlinked targets, publication failure, interrupted recovery and completed-plan reruns; existing bounded tests pass without weakening behavior assertions.
results.observation: Consumer-visible rejection, rollback, interruption, recovery-conflict, namespace and idempotence regressions plus temporary-policy audit pass; complete suite is 15 modules, zero failed.

results.criterion: AC7: Independent Standards and Spec review covers the full planner/executor/CLI change against a pinned baseline, with stable finding IDs and no unresolved blocker unless explicitly accepted by the user. Real acceptance observations and artifact hashes cover every PRD success criterion.
results.observation: Independent Standards review approved after round 2 and Spec review converged in round 3; stable finding ledger preserves resolutions and the retraction.
